_about: Khai bao lap rap Cu Bong v3 (spec-owl-v3-assembly.md, Claude 2026-11-27). Vo truoc = khung, nam ngua (mat rap len tren, +y huong len); moi chi tiet dat theo -y hoac day tu ngoai (+y) va co dinh ngay. Ban v2 (s3-screen) xem git.
